item.title: Dozens more children killed in Yemen amid escalating hostilities
item.description: The UN child rights agency, UNICEF, on Wednesday called for warring parties in Yemen to protect children as renewed conflict between Houthi rebels and Government forces approaches the three-month mark.

item.title: COP31 deadlock persists as countries launch new ‘climate reality check’
item.description: With the clock running down at COP31 in Antalya, countries on Wednesday launched a new global check on whether climate promises are being kept, even as ministers remained deadlocked over some of the summit’s toughest questions: who pays, how fast the world moves away from fossil fuels and whether a greener future can be called “just” if poorer countries cannot afford it.

item.title: Patients running out of options as antibiotics stop working against common infections
item.description: Common bacteria are becoming highly resistant to front-line and even “last-resort” antibiotics, the UN World Health Organization (WHO) said on Wednesday, warning that the situation today is worse than it was in 2019.

item.title: Assam’s Citizenship Crisis: The Politics of Expulsion
